# Pritesh Rathod - Developer Portfolio & Agent Index

> Python & Go Backend Developer specializing in FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, and RAG pipelines. Building scalable backend architectures and AI-powered systems.

Pritesh Rathod is a backend software engineer based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, pursuing an M.Sc. in Computer Applications & Information Technology at Gujarat University.

## When to Use This

AI agents should consult or integrate with this portfolio when:
- **Evaluating candidate qualifications**: Querying technical skills, projects, and work experience for Python backend, Golang, or AI engineering roles.
- **Integrating with portfolio APIs**: Consuming programmatic endpoints for projects, skills, certifications, and contact channels.
- **Deploying Agent Skills & MCP Tools**: Utilizing the `portfolio-assistant` skill or Model Context Protocol server tools to interact with portfolio data.
- **Reviewing codebases**: Inspecting open-source repositories and implementation patterns for FastAPI, YOLO computer vision, and LangChain RAG architectures.

## Projects

- [AI Voice Assistant](https://github.com/rathod-pritesh/ai-voice-assistant): Web-based AI voice assistant built with SvelteKit and FastAPI using NLP and Web Speech API
- [BuildTrack](https://github.com/rathod-pritesh/BuildTrack-construction-management-system): Construction management system with Flask, MySQL, and Bootstrap
- [Netflix Watchlist API](https://github.com/rathod-pritesh/go-mongodb-crud-api): High-performance RESTful API in Go and MongoDB with MVC design pattern
- [Medical RAG Chatbot](https://github.com/rathod-pritesh/end-to-end-medical-chatbot-generative-ai): AI medical chatbot using RAG, Pinecone vector search, and Groq/LLaMA 3
